    # Original reads correct batch data; mutant reads garbage for batches > 0

    predictions = torch.rand(128, 4096, device=device, dtype=torch.float32) + 0.1
    targets = torch.rand(128, 4096, device=device, dtype=torch.float32) + 0.1

    return [predictions, targets]
